text:
jess: quick report — samplekit JS is failing schema validation when an auth refresh triggers a retry mid-stream in json_mode. Observed on on-prem QA.

samir: oh no. minimal repro?

jess: yes. sequence: 1) start samplekit generate with `json_mode: true` + tool that streams structured chunks 2) force token expiry during the stream 3) SDK retries final fragments and the stitcher produces an invalid concatenation like `][` so the validator crashes.

jess: log snippet:
```
INFO  stream chunk 4: "\n]"
WARN  auth: token expired, refreshing
INFO  retrying stream request
INFO  stream chunk 5 (replay): "[\n{\"result\":1}\n"
ERROR schema-validator: unexpected token at pos 1
```

maya: hm. is the stitcher stateful across retries? it should reset on a stream restart, or use framing so replayed prefixes don't break parsing.

andre: current stitcher in sdk-js does `buffer += chunk` and tries `JSON.parse(buffer)` on boundaries. it never checks for replay markers. naive concat is the culprit.

samir: two fixes: (1) short-term patch — be permissive in validator for leading/trailing separators when `json_mode: true` (strip stray `[`/`]` or separators before parse), (2) long-term — add a per-stream session id + chunk-index header so the client can detect replay and either drop duplicates or reset stitcher.

jess: agreed. also think we should emit an event when retry occurs so dx tooling can annotate streams in logs. that would make debugging far easier.

maya: i'll add a unit test in sdk-js that simulates chunk replay: send `"[\n{\"a\":1}\n` then simulate retry that replays `"[\n{\"b\":2}\n` and assert final assembled array is `[{\"a\":1},{\"b\":2}]` not `[{\"a\":1}][{\"b\":2}]`.

andre: i'll PR a small change to the stitcher: if a retry is observed (http header `x-retry: 1`), reset buffer before consuming replayed chunks. also add defensive trimming of stray separators when parsing.

samir: should we also update the docs / quickstart samplekit to warn about auth edgecases in streaming + JSON mode? onboarding folks hit this for sure.

jess: yes, add a note in samplekit README and a troubleshooting blurb.

devx-bot: created issue #4456: "sdk-js: streaming json_mode - auth-refresh retry causes invalid fragment concatenation" (assigned: andre, maya)

jess: thanks all — i'll add the failing run logs to the issue and link the QA repro environment.

maya: i'll push the unit test + docs tweak tomorrow morning.

andre: will draft the stitcher fix and add the session-id header patch. ETA EOD.

samir: nice. follow-up: we should audit other SDKs (py/ts) for same pattern.

jess: adding that to the issue checklist.
